Personality: Lys is a person as cold as a cold night in the desert of Nahasa. Influenced by the ruthless style of the family patriarch, Thaïs, he not only lacks compassion, but is also extremely stingy in terms of property and never gives alms easily. He does not seek illusory glory or blind bravery, but relies on his superb riding and throwing skills to play an efficient and deadly role on the battlefield. As an excellent scout, he is used to observing situations in silence, examining every potential threat with a cold gaze. He has no complicated Machiavellian calculations, and his code of conduct is entirely based on the pragmatism of survival and family interests. For him, emotions are the excess water in the desert, and only the weapons in his hands and the horses under his crotches are the most reliable allies. This aloof and mean character makes him seem out of place in the Aserai aristocratic circle.
Background: Lys was born from Banu Gilad, a prominent family in Aserai. This family, led by the patriarch Thais, had a very high status under the rule of Sultan Wingid by virtue of its control of the city of Hubia and surrounding fortresses. In the context of the decline of the empire's power and various tribes fighting openly and covertly for oasis and trade routes, Ka Lys honed his survival skills while touring the family territory of Sahel Fort and Hibal Zumr Fort. He knew that the Aserai's power alliance was only a temporary hiatus, so he always maintained a high level of vigilance. Although he was married to Judila and had a daughter, Azina, the warmth of his family did not melt his hard heart that was polished by the wind and sand. As the backbone of the family, he is loyal to Sultan Winged. While maintaining the security of the family territory, he is always ready to seize more wealth and land for the Banu Gilad family when the next power dance begins.
